title: Python Loop else Clause
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and behavior of python loop else clause.
Write syntactically correct loop code using appropriate indentation.
Trace loop execution for representative inputs.
Select a suitable loop-control statement for a task.
Apply iteration to a practical collection or counting problem.

understand.concept: Python allows an else clause on both for and while loops. The else suite runs when the loop finishes normally, including when a while condition becomes false or a for iterable is exhausted. It does not run when the loop exits through break. A continue does not by itself suppress the else clause.
understand.whyItMatters: Loop else is useful for search operations where a success-triggered break should distinguish a found item from a search that completed without finding it.
understand.analogy: It is like a search report that is shown only when the search finishes without an early stop.
understand.analogyLimit: The loop else clause is not the same as an if/else attached to each iteration; it belongs to the loop as a whole.

explain.narrative:
## 1. for-else

The else suite runs after the iterable is exhausted normally.

## 2. while-else

The else suite runs when the loop condition becomes false.

## 3. break suppresses loop else

If break terminates the loop, its else suite is skipped. continue does not suppress else.

## 4. Common search pattern

Use break when a target is found; place the not-found message in the loop's else suite.

examples.title: for loop completes normally
examples.explanation: The iterable is exhausted without break, so else runs.

examples.title: for loop exits with break
examples.explanation: break terminates the loop, so the loop else suite is skipped.

examples.title: Search and report not found
examples.explanation: The loop exhausts the collection without break, so else reports failure.

examples.title: Search and find target
examples.explanation: The target triggers break, preventing the else suite from running.

examples.title: continue still allows else
examples.explanation: continue skips an iteration but normal exhaustion still occurs.

practise.guidedTask: Search a list for a requested item using for-else. Print a not-found message only if no item matched.
practise.independentTask: Implement a prime-number check for a positive integer using a loop, break for a divisor, and else for the no-divisor case. Handle values below two separately.
